newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Caspian initiates Argentina's San Miguel with buy.
newsitem.headline: Caspian initiates Argentina's San Miguel with buy.

text.p: Caspian Securities said it initiated San Miguel, Argentina's main lemon producer, with a buy recommendation.

Analyst Clara Cardoner wrote in a report she had a 1998 year-end price target of $32.5, implying a return of 29 percent. EPS are expected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 31.1 percent over the next two years.

Share price appreciation should be driven by expected 37.5 percent industrial and 10.5 percent packing capacity increase, productivity gains from recent acquisitions and additional growth expected from new projects to be announced shortly, Cardoner said.
San Miguel is responsible for eight percent of the world output. It produces lemons and industrializaed products used in beverage, food and cosmetic industries.
